# Synthetic Parser Output Fixtures

These fixtures are synthetic and are not real evidence. They are safe for
repository use and exist only to test parser contracts and later normalization
code.

The rows are intentionally small and fake. They are not authoritative examples
of every real MFTECmd, RECmd, or AmcacheParser column, and they were not
generated by running forensic tools against case data.

Do not replace these files with real parser output, official case artifacts,
hostnames, usernames, secrets, private paths, or generated evidence outputs.
